# Debrief: Argo CD, cert-manager, Envoy, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Istio, Kubernetes

These clips give the team practical guidance on Argo CD patterns and pitfalls, plus Istio ambient, cert-manager, Envoy and Prometheus-related context that touches the stack. ([Declarative...ish? Fixing Hidden Argo CD Pitfalls in Your GitOps Setup · 16:45](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VfVQj4Oa3z0&t=1005s); [The Good, The Ugly, and The Bad: Leaving Sidecars Behind with Istio Ambient Mesh · 21:59](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ToKv7JntLvY&t=1319s); [Cert-manager – Project Update: Beyond 2026 · 1:01](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vzBGkY_HIyM&t=61s); [Evolution or Revolution: Istio as the Network Platform for Cloud Native · 13:08](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4K6s5y8HoBc&t=788s); [Envoy in the Era of Agentic Workloads · 20:51](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HvX4nGkhfZw&t=1251s))

## Top 3 takeaways

1. Writing individual Argo CD applications per cluster is an anti-pattern; one ApplicationSet can replace many, such as 50 apps for five infrastructure components (cert-manager, Prometheus, Istio) across ten clusters. ([Declarative...ish? Fixing Hidden Argo CD Pitfalls in Your GitOps Setup · 16:45](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VfVQj4Oa3z0&t=1005s))
2. Moving to Istio ambient surfaced friction: cert-manager needs an experimental feature enabled, and Gateway API support requires plugins in tools like Argo Rollouts, which meant updating several tools. ([The Good, The Ugly, and The Bad: Leaving Sidecars Behind with Istio Ambient Mesh · 21:59](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ToKv7JntLvY&t=1319s))
3. Previewing pull request changes with Argo CD should use a dedicated instance, not production, because the tool creates and deletes many applications and can overload and crash the instance. ([Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 8:41](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=521s))

## Action items

- [ ] Audit your Argo CD repos for hand-written per-cluster Application manifests and Helm charts that generate Applications, and try replacing them with an ApplicationSet. ([Declarative...ish? Fixing Hidden Argo CD Pitfalls in Your GitOps Setup · 16:45](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VfVQj4Oa3z0&t=1005s); [Declarative...ish? Fixing Hidden Argo CD Pitfalls in Your GitOps Setup · 14:28](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VfVQj4Oa3z0&t=868s))
- [ ] Before evaluating Istio ambient, list tools relying on cert-manager or Argo Rollouts traffic management and check what experimental flags or Gateway API plugins they would need. ([The Good, The Ugly, and The Bad: Leaving Sidecars Behind with Istio Ambient Mesh · 21:59](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ToKv7JntLvY&t=1319s))
- [ ] If you try Argo CD diff previews on pull requests, set up a dedicated Argo CD instance for previews rather than pointing the tool at production. ([Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 8:41](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=521s))

## Watch together (8 min)

1. [Declarative...ish? Fixing Hidden Argo CD Pitfalls in Your GitOps Setup · 16:45](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VfVQj4Oa3z0&t=1005s) (1:22), Regina Voloshin: Concrete ApplicationSet advice covering cert-manager, Prometheus and Istio across clusters.
2. [The Good, The Ugly, and The Bad: Leaving Sidecars Behind with Istio Ambient Mesh · 21:59](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ToKv7JntLvY&t=1319s) (1:21), Alfonso Ming, Jorge Turrado: Real ambient migration friction involving cert-manager, Argo Rollouts and Gateway API.
3. [Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 8:41](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=521s) (2:21), Dag Bjerre Andersen, Sergey Shevchenko: Warns against previewing on production Argo CD; recommends a dedicated instance.
4. [Evolution or Revolution: Istio as the Network Platform for Cloud Native · 13:08](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4K6s5y8HoBc&t=788s) (1:19), Mitch Connors, Daniel Grimm: Explains ztunnel in Istio ambient: L4 routing and mTLS on the node.
5. [Evolution or Revolution: Istio as the Network Platform for Cloud Native · 17:29](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4K6s5y8HoBc&t=1049s) (1:18), Mitch Connors, Daniel Grimm: Istio traffic features and Prometheus/OpenTelemetry observability, plus multi-cluster context.
